# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `tiendanube` MCP server pointing at Tiendanube's hosted endpoint (`https://admin-mcp.tiendanube.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth; each connection operates on one store.
- Logo: Tiendanube's mark from the `TiendaNube` GitHub organization, 256×256.
